description: Agent Capacity: submit an agent’s current workload with its stated capacity: optionally the agent with its id and name; the capacity with the most work the agent is stated to hold at once, its unit, who stated it and when; each item of work in hand with its id, what it is, the units of capacity it takes (1 when left out) and its state (active, waiting or blocked); each utilization sample with its date or time, the load in hand then and the utilization the system recorded in percent; and optionally the days over the limit after which an overload counts as sustained (3 when left out). The signed report gives the capacity, the work in hand with its units, its share of the limit and the units held by blocked work, every sample with its load read as a share of the limit beside the recorded figure, and every run of samples over the limit as an episode with its span, its peak and whether it is sustained, and counts them, and names an agent over capacity: work in hand over the stated limit, an overload that lasts the whole window and a sample over the limit recorded at or under 100%; then brief spikes over the limit, a load at 90% or more of the limit, blocked work holding capacity and recorded utilization more than 5 points off the load, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No stated limit, no work in hand or no utilization record leaves the workload unverified. This reads the units of work in hand against the stated capacity over time: an agent’s promised hours against its due dates are wever_commitment-deadline-check, where a limit is enforced is wever_limit-substrate-check and running agents triaged from a status snapshot are wever_agent-attention-brief. Verdict capacity_workload_over, capacity_workload_partial, capacity_workload_unverified or capacity_workload_within. POST /api/capacity-workload-check. Reads the load and capacity records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Capacity reads an agent’s own load and capacity records and checks the load against the capacity that exists: work in hand against the stated limit, a queue against its target wait, concurrent runs against the cap, an allowance’s burn against its period, a backlog across a window, spare capacity against the reserve, the scaling plan against the burn, and admission at capacity against written priority rules. Beside it, the Agent Limits checks such as wever_limit-substrate-check read whether a limit sits in code or in prose and how it is scoped, changed and seen, while a capacity check reads the load itself against the capacity; wever_commitment-deadline-check reads promised hours against due dates, while the workload check reads the work in hand against the stated limit over time; and the Agent Triage checks such as wever_triage-priority-check read how queue items are ranked, reviewed and closed, while the queue, backlog and throttle checks read waits, size and admission against capacity. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-capacity-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-capacity/.

limit.description: The most work the agent is stated to hold at once, in the unit below.

units.description: Units of capacity it takes; 1 when left out.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

sustained_days.description: Days over the limit after which an overload counts as sustained; 3 when left out.

at.description: A date or time, such as 2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T14:00Z.

load.description: Work in hand at that time, in the capacity unit.

recorded_pct.description: Utilization as the system recorded it, in percent.

name: wever_capacity-workload-check
title: Capacity workload check
